relevance_note: The review gives individual-level detail for at least one HA20 patient, e.g. 'A patient with ALPS presented with fevers, bilateral cervical lymphadenopathy, extensive skin rash, and massive hepatosplenomegaly' (35), with the variant 'p.Gln415fs (35)'.
method_note: Narrative review (HA20, otulipenia, LUBAC deficiency). Read in full by hand; Table 2 row segments were cut from the Markdown by a short script (split on cell separators) and each was checked against the table; all spans verified verbatim by script. In scope: (1) 'ref (35) patient', the single Japanese ALPS patient, described in text and in Table 2 column 8, header 'Patients (35) (n = 1)' under 'HA20 (16, 35–37)'; this one-patient column was treated as a patient column (1/1 = observed, 0/1 = excluded, '/' = not reported per the table note); evidence_basis 'stated for this individual' because n = 1. (2) 'ref (16) patient', the one patient of Zhou et al.'s 11 'initially diagnosed with SLE'; features from Table 2 column 5 'Patients (16) (n = 11)' were applied only where the count is all-or-none (11/11 observed, 0/11 excluded), as 'inferred from group statement'; partial counts (e.g. 2/11, and 'Elevated CRP, ESR' 6/6 within n = 11) were not applied. (3)-(4) 'unnamed person 1' and 'unnamed person 2', the patients 'with HA20' in Figure 3D and 3E legends; the paper does not say whether they are the same person, nor their source, though the Zhou et al. (16) sentence cites 'Figures 3D,E', so they may duplicate each other or ref (16) patients. Out of scope / no rows: the other 10 ref (16) patients and the ref (36) (n = 3) and ref (37) (n = 6) families, described only as counts; OTULIN, HOIL-1 and HOIP patients; TNFAIP3 common risk variants. Variant for ref (35): the review renames the reported p.Gln415fs (35) to p.Lys417Serfs*4 and the reported c.1245_1248del to c.1249_1252del (3′ rule); the review's proposed forms are recorded, the reported forms are in the spans. No transcript printed. Ref (16) patient's variant is only in Figure 2 ('Mutations reported by Zhou at al.'), so variant_original_string is 'not reported'. Zygosity left 'not reported': heterozygosity is stated only for HA20 in general (Table 1), not per person. n_patients_reported left null: the authors give per-source n (11, 6, 3, 1) but no total. Ref (35) 'Effective treatment' cells '0/1; 0/1; 0/1' do not say which treatments were given, so treatment_summary is 'not reported'. 'Failure to thrive' 0/n was not used to exclude checklist 'growth failure' (narrower term), and 'Lymphadenopathy' 0/11 not used to exclude 'lymphoproliferation or lymphadenopathy'. Internal inconsistencies in Table 2 (not affecting in-scope rows except as noted): the ref (36) column header says n = 3 but its 'Effective treatment' cells read '0/6; 0/6; 0/6'; 'Elevated CRP, ESR' uses denominator 6 in the n = 11 column and 1 in the n = 6 column.
